title: introduce-telemetry-correlation-hub-and-alert-prioritizer
author: Ava Chen
description: Motivation: Customers repeatedly request better correlation between token-level cost spikes, kernel/backpressure metrics, and the sparse logs/trace fragments we capture. This PR adds a Telemetry Correlation Hub: an index + lightweight merge pipeline that synthesizes compact span digests, token-cost fingerprints, and contextual log anchors to improve triage and to drive an alert prioritizer that reduces noisy SRE toil. Design summary: - Introduce correlation index (compact-correlation-key) derived from invocation signature + first-3-token hash + kernel-shape fingerprint. - Lightweight merge step at ingestion that joins sampled spans, cost-attribution rows, and log anchors into a compact "tracelet" document stored in the telemetry store. - Alert prioritizer component that computes a per-anomaly priority score (severity*cost-impact*entropy) and attaches a reason vector used by the console to surface next-best-actions. - Dashboard additions: "Correlation Explorer" with lane view (cost, kernel-queue, span-count), and a Golden-Path heatmap for correlated alerts. - New telemetry fields: telemetry.correlation_key, telemetry.priority_score, telemetry.reason_vector (1..5 tags), and span.digest_v2 (compact base64). - No changes to public API surface; internal instrumentation only. Checklist: [x] index/key design, [x] ingestion merge pipeline, [x] prometheus/otel metrics + tags, [x] console dashboard panels, [x] alert-prioritizer rules + unit tests, [x] e2e synthetic replay smoke test, [x] rollout gating and feature flag. Migration/rollout: Feature gated behind ff.telemetry_correlation_hub; default off for Dedicated/Private. Step 1: rollout to observability-canary for 48h; Step 2: opt-in tenants; Step 3: global enable and alert-rule migration. Backwards compatibility: older traces without correlation_key remain queryable; index is best-effort and additive. Security & Privacy: correlation_key is keyed hash; log anchors are pseudonymized where required by tenant policy. Performance: ingest merge implemented with bounded window and sampling (1% global but can be increased per-tenant). Expected ingestion CPU + mem ~ +2-3% in canary. Testing: unit tests for index generation; integration tests for join correctness; replaybench runs showing <5% added p50 ingest latency in synthetic high-throughput. Commits summary: "index: add correlation_key generator and tests"; "ingest: correlation merge pipeline and schema migration"; "diag: add priority_score calculator and rule config"; "console: add Correlation Explorer panels and drilldown links"; "alerting: add alert-prioritizer and migration script"; "docs: telemetry correlation runbook and config guide". Changed files (high-level): ["services/telemetry/indexer/correlation_indexer.py","services/telemetry/pipeline/merge_stage.go","schemas/telemetry_v3.sql","observability/dashboards/correlation_explorer.json","alerting/prioritizer/rules.yaml","alerting/migrations/20260215_migrate_priorities.sql","sdk/otel/enricher.py","tests/ingest/test_correlation_indexer.py","tests/alerting/test_prioritizer.py","docs/runbooks/telemetry-correlation.md","docs/console/correlation-explorer.md","ci/replaybench/config.yaml"] Review thread summary: - Diego Martinez (requested changes 2026-02-11): "The correlation_key must avoid exposing token prefixes for PII-sensitive tenants; convert to HMAC with tenant-salt or use truncated bloom. Also add a canary toggle per-region." -> Author (2026-02-12): "Switched to HMAC-SHA256 with tenant salt, added per-region FF; updated tests." - Priya Nair (comment 2026-02-13): "Can we add a synthetic scenario that reproduces a long-tail cost spike tying kernel queueing to token splice?" -> Author (2026-02-13): "Added synthetic scenario in replaybench config and linked job in CI." - Omar Haddad (approved 2026-02-14): "Design looks sound; priority scoring config is readable and has sensible defaults." - Ops note from Alice Gupta (comment 2026-02-14): "Observability retention might increase due to priority tags; added storage budget checks and opt-outs." Author replies and fixed issues across 3 follow-up commits. CI checks: ["unit-tests: pass","integration-tests: pass","lint: pass","replaybench: pass","e2e-smoke: pass","security-scan: pass"] Merge outcome: merged via squash on 2026-02-15 after approvals and green CI. Release notes: "Add Telemetry Correlation Hub: synthesizes compact tracelets that correlate token-cost, kernel-level signals, and log anchors; includes a console Correlation Explorer and an alert prioritizer to reduce noisy alerts and improve triage. Feature is feature-flagged and disabled by default." Rollout and monitoring runbook: See docs/runbooks/telemetry-correlation.md; primary monitors added: telemetry.correlation_ingest_errors, telemetry.priority_score_dist, telemetry.tracelet_ingest_latency_p50/p95. Known limitations: correlation misses under extreme sampling; priority_score tuning will require 2 weeks of telemetry to stabilize. Future work: persistent tracelet indices for fast cross-tenant search, adaptive sampling based on priority, and alert-suppression playbook integration.
